review_type: independent source-to-output semantic review after completion
scope: Three engineered equipment-library acceptance documents. These are neither blind production data nor a statistically representative corpus.
assessment: The output preserves the declared substantive cases and all planned sections, with clean business prose and working exact-source links. It is not semantically error-free: unsupported strengthening, misplaced conditions and irrelevant citation support survived an accepted model audit. No percentage of overall information accuracy is inferred.

declared_criteria.reason: Both normal prerequisites retained; staff exception separately stated.
Membership remains mandatory and the recorded charge survives the waiver.
Successful identity check is necessary and failed checks do not establish fraud.
48-hour expiry and unspecified history retention retained, but 5.3 additionally invents an availability guarantee; see finding F1.
Other items stay reserved; user chooses wait/removal; no automatic substitution.
Evening service remains an unapproved proposal and unavailable.
Original due date remains until approval.
Mismatch review is neither automatic approval nor permanent rejection.
Recorded authorization and delegate's own unexpired document are both required.
Outcome/reviewer reference retained; no identity-document image storage.
Timeout-only single retry and unchanged deadline retained; 5.4 adds an unspecified staff actor, and 'exactly one' can read as obligatory rather than an allowed retry.
Incomplete result cannot authorize; complete result alone is insufficient.
One seven-day extension and approval condition retained in detailed sections, but overview moves the conflict check to request eligibility; see F3.
Rejected extension leaves original due date unchanged.
Missing accessories and damage have independent outcomes, including complete but damaged items.
Two return locations apply to tools; no audio-equipment inference.
30 and 45 days after notice coexist with no invented winner.

findings.output_quote: Item reservations guarantee availability for 48 hours following confirmation
findings.source_quote: Reservations hold an available item for 48 hours after the confirmation time.
findings.reason: A hold on an available item does not establish a guarantee. The same source separately allows an unavailable item in a reservation.

findings.output_quote: fixed policies rather than client-configurable settings
source_quotes: Reservations hold an available item for 48 hours after the confirmation time.
A resident can request one extension of seven days.
findings.reason: Specified business values do not establish whether an implementation exposes client configuration. The paragraph correctly admits missing configuration information immediately afterward, contradicting its initial certainty.

findings.output_quote: may request a 7-day extension if no conflicting holds exist
findings.source_quote: A resident can request one extension of seven days. Approval requires that no subsequent reservation conflicts with the extended period.
findings.reason: The source constrains approval, not the right to submit a request. The detailed sections correctly attach the condition to approval, leaving an internal inconsistency.

findings.output_quote: No user interface mockups, screen layouts, or visual assets are provided in the source documentation.

# Community equipment library

findings.reason: The absence statement agrees with the supplied files, but the cited title and test notice do not establish it. A corpus/inventory absence observation needs explicit provenance, not an unrelated quote.

findings.output_quote: identity verification upon collection, seven-day loan extension reviews, and multi-point return inspections
findings.reason: Most summary concepts are described elsewhere in the originals, but this paragraph cites only local projects and the evening-service proposal. A citation on a paragraph currently does not establish support for every factual clause.

mechanical_verification.audit_targets: No findings or repairs in this run, so valid repair targeting is not exercised here.

readability.assessment: Clear headings, concise paragraphs, useful lists, footnotes and no audit mechanics. Readability is improved over operational-diagnostic prose.
limitations: Repeated overviews and detailed rules make a very small corpus unnecessarily long.
The input template creates an empty UI directory topic and an unsupported configuration assertion; its absence of domain evidence should not pressure generation to invent content.

audit_assessment.independent_conclusion: The audit missed material semantic errors. Its estimate must not be reported as independently measured accuracy or information preservation.

smallest_generic_pipeline_improvements: Writer and auditor should check that every factual clause has an attached quote that supports that clause, not merely an existing citation on the paragraph.

Preserve which action a condition constrains, the direction of implication, modality, actor and scope. Do not strengthen permissions into obligations, holds into guarantees, or silence about configurability into a negative configuration claim.
Treat corpus-level absence observations as inventory-derived metadata with explicit provenance. Never attach a title or unrelated excerpt as purported proof of absence.

For template sections without source support, express the unsupported scope minimally and accurately, or identify the empty plan section before writing; do not infer domain behavior to fill the template.
Keep these checks inside the existing writer and audit requests rather than adding another unbounded audit loop.
